stimulus.bodyText: CITY POOL. Children under seven must come with an adult. The small pool is warm. The big pool is cold. Please put your shoes in the green box. The pool closes at six o'clock.

stimulus.bodyText: SCHOOL BUS. The bus comes at half past seven every morning. Wait behind the yellow line. Do not eat on the bus. Please talk quietly. There is no bus on Sunday.

stimulus.title: Nora's New Bicycle
stimulus.bodyText: Nora was seven years old. Her old bicycle was very small, and her legs were too long for it. On her birthday her father gave her a big blue bicycle. Nora was happy, but she could not ride it. She fell down two times. Then her brother Tim helped her every day, and she went slowly down the road. On Sunday Nora went all the way to the park on her new bicycle. 'Look at me!' she said. Now the small bicycle is Tim's bicycle.

questions.prompt: Why was Nora's old bicycle a problem?
Who helped Nora with the new bicycle?
When did Nora go to the park on her bicycle?
Who has the small bicycle now?

stimulus.title: A Day in the Snow
stimulus.bodyText: On Friday morning there was a lot of snow in the town. There was no school, so Ben and his sister Ida put on hats and boots. They made two snow men in the garden. The snow men had carrots for noses. Then the children were very cold, so they went inside. Their father made hot milk for them. In the afternoon the sun came out. At five o'clock the snow men were very small. Ben took a photo of them.

questions.prompt: Why was there no school on Friday?
How many snow men did the children make?
What did the father make for the children?
Why were the snow men very small at five o'clock?

stimulus.title: Max and the Big Egg
stimulus.bodyText: Max lives on a small farm with his family. One morning he went to see the hens. Under a tree he found a very big white egg. It was warm. Max put the egg in a box in the kitchen, next to the window. Two days later the egg opened. A little duck came out. Max was very happy. He called the duck Ben. Now Ben is not in a box. He walks after Max all day, like a small dog.

questions.prompt: Where did Max find the egg?
What did Max do with the egg?
